title: carlina chamaeleon
intro: Carlina chamaeleon, commonly known as Edelweiss or Chamois Flower, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant is believed to exert therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting immune function due to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. Additionally, Carlina chamaeleon has been studied for its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health.
